CNR No:PBJL010206762025 CASE No:CMA-194-2025
NIKU Vs SULAKHAN SINGH
Present: 
Sh. Rishabh Gumber, Advocate for appellant. 
As per report respondent has been served through telephone
but  has  gone unrepresented. Let fresh notice to respondent be issued
through  RC/AD  on filing of the same along-with fresh copies within a
week with Ahlmad for 17.04.2026. Notice to Sh. H.S. Sandhu, Advocate
of respondent also be issued for the date fixed. 
Date of Order: 18.02.2026
Anurupit*
( Rajeev K. Beri)
Addl.District  Judge-I, Jalandhar
UID No . PB00149
